When you tap one of the answers, the default color of the pressed button is changed to green (when it was the right answer) or to red (wrong answer). You have 3 attempts to give the right answer.  If you give it at the first attempt you will receive 3 points, at the second attempt - 2 points, at the third - 1 point. After the second wrong answer the hint with the capital of the country will be shown. Play the "Name This Country" quiz now and find out how well you know your world!
